reviews.title: Worked for a total of 5 min
reviews.comment: So this PSU lasted for about 5 min. I was not sure if the psu was bad or not. But this is the only part that was not new. So I put psu I bought into my current PC and still did not work, Put the original back into my current pc and it boot and ran just fine.  The psu does not work. Avoid this seller cause I do not think Corsair refurbished it.
reviews.author: Sean
